Director of Engineering – Connected Enterprise Solutions

Molex CES | Lisle, IL | On-site | Travel:10-15%(Global)

Your Job

Molex's Connected Enterprise Solutions business is entering a period of strategic growth. With data centers expanding rapidly to support infrastructure and enterprise networks undergoing significant modernization, CES occupies a critical position in the connectivity market, delivering comprehensive copper and fiber infrastructure solutions supported by Molex's global engineering capabilities and a legacy of manufacturing excellence.

The Director of Engineering
will play a central role in defining the technical strategy of CES, leading a team with established strengths and the opportunity to drive meaningful advancement in fiber connectivity and broader portfolio performance across Enterprise and Data Center markets.

What You Will Lead

Set engineering strategy — Define and own priorities across sustaining, qualification, and innovation engineering. Translate market signals and business objectives into a clear, sequenced roadmap that the team can execute against.
Protect what's working — Ensure the stability, quality, and lifecycle performance of an established product portfolio through disciplined sustaining engineering.
Accelerate what's next — Drive qualification and integration of new technologies, with a sharp focus on fiber-led solutions for enterprise and hyperscale data center applications.
Build the pipeline — Lead delivery of new products from concept through launch. Own the outcomes — commercially and technically.
Be a cross-functional partner — Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain to ensure engineering programs are grounded in customer needs and market reality.
Develop the team — Build a capable, accountable engineering organization that combines technical depth with a strong ownership mindset. Coach individuals at different stages of their careers.
Contribute to business leadership — Serve as a key member of the CES leadership team, bringing an engineering lens to broader business strategy and decisions.
Lead with business and financial acumen — Manage engineering resources and investments with an ownership mindset, making sound trade-off decisions that balance innovation, execution, risk, cost, and long-term value creation. Partner with business leaders to ensure technical priorities support profitable growth and strategic objectives.

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

5 to 7+ years of engineering leadership experience, ideally in connectivity, physical layer infrastructure, or an adjacent hardware/technology domain.
You've led a team through change. Whether that's building from scratch, integrating new technology, or shifting a team's culture, you've done it, and you know the difference between managing the org chart and actually leading people.
Proven at building and running teams, including teams in transition or earlier stages of maturity. You know how to establish culture, not just inherit it.
Track record of product delivery, you've shipped products that customers buy. You understand what it takes to get from concept to qualified, manufacturable solutions.
Operationally disciplined, comfortable balancing long-cycle innovation work with the cadence of sustaining and qualification programs running in parallel.
Driven by outcomes, not activity. You hold yourself and others accountable to results.

What Will Put You Ahead

Deep expertise in fiber technologies, including pre-terminated systems, high-density fiber, splicing, and/or emerging data center fiber architectures.
Experience integrating acquired or market-ready technologies into an existing product portfolio.
Familiarity with enterprise structured cabling standards or data center infrastructure standards.
Experience working within or alongside a global manufacturing and supply chain organization.
Bachelor's degree and/or advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Optical Engineering, or related technical discipline.

For this role, we anticipate paying $180,000 - $200,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

Relocation benefits may be provided. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

Molex CES delivers high-performance copper and fiber infrastructure for enterprise buildings and data centers globally. Our product portfolio spans structured cabling, pre-terminated fiber systems, and high-density data center solutions, all supported by Molex's global manufacturing and supply chain capabilities.
You'll be leading an engineering team in a business unit with real commercial momentum, meaningful product complexity, and the backing of a global organization (Molex is a Koch Industries company).

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is seeking a Director of Software & Firmware Engineering to lead the organization responsible for the software and firmware that operate our energy storage products. Reporting to the Senior Director of Software Engineering & Test Engineering, this leader will oversee embedded software and firmware, the applications used to commission and service our products, and the engineering support required throughout development and the deployed lifecycle. You will bring together product software, firmware, lifecycle applications, and operational support into a cohesive engineering organization with clear ownership and strong technical discipline. This is an opportunity to shape the architecture, teams, and operating model behind a complex, software-enabled energy product with meaningful impact on the electric grid.

Relocation assistance is available.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop engineering managers, senior technical leaders, individual contributors, and contractors across embedded software, firmware, systems engineering, manufacturing software, and fleet operations.
Establish an integrated engineering strategy across requirements, architecture, reusable product platforms, firmware delivery, deployment, and operational support.
Drive a requirements-first and tooling-first approach to software development, safety, security, compliance, and technical evidence.
Build reusable software and firmware platforms spanning operating systems, middleware, networking, device runtime, simulation, build systems, release tooling, deployment interfaces, and secure OTA delivery mechanisms.
Lead the organization responsible for product firmware delivery, integration, debugging, release readiness, system bring-up, rapid prototyping, fixtures, and supporting engineering tools.
Oversee the production rollout and operation of deployed software, including fleet observability, production SRE, OTA execution, commissioning and service applications, incident response, and long-term fleet reliability.
Ensure commissioning, service, field, product, and test organizations receive effective software and firmware support throughout the product lifecycle.
Develop integrated staffing and execution plans, identify technical and organizational risks early, and drive clear prioritization decisions across competing product needs.
Partner closely with Product Management, hardware, controls, manufacturing, field operations, regulatory teams, Engineering Automation, and Product Quality.
Build a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, technical rigor, rapid learning, maintainability, modularity, reuse, and long-term fleet operability.

What You'll Bring

15+ years of experience in software, firmware, embedded systems, or product systems engineering, including significant experience leading managers and multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
Demonstrated success delivering complex software-enabled physical products through architecture, implementation, integration, verification, production, deployment, and field operation.
Strong technical depth in embedded software and firmware, operating systems, middleware, networking, distributed systems, and hardware/software interfaces.
Experience establishing requirements, systems architecture, technical governance, verification strategy, and engineering processes across multiple teams.
Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain strong engineering managers and technical leaders while building clear organizational ownership and accountability.
Demonstrated ability to translate product priorities into staffing, investment, sequencing, and delivery decisions, make difficult tradeoffs, and communicate technical and organizational risks to executive and cross-functional audiences.

Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.

When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

Collins Aerospace is seeking a seasoned technical executive to serve as the Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (SEIT) Chief Engineer for the SAOC program. This leader is responsible for all systems engineering, integration, verification, validation, and test execution activities across the program. The SEIT Chief Engineer ensures technical integrity, disciplined engineering execution, requirements alignment, and full system coherence across all IPTs. This role incorporates expanded responsibilities, including technical baseline governance, engineering process excellence, and enterprise integration consistent with senior director expectations.

What You Will Do

Provide executive-level technical leadership for all SAOC systems engineering, integration, verification, validation, and test activities.
Govern the end-to-end technical baseline, ensuring requirements, architecture, interfaces, integration sequencing, and verification strategies remain aligned with program and customer objectives.
Drive system-level integration from lab environments through HWIL/SIL, ground testing, and flight testing to ensure robust, mission-ready performance.
Lead long-range technical strategy and forward-looking architecture planning to ensure mission resilience, system continuity, and evolving operational capability.
Ensure strong alignment across IPTs and across engineering domains such as software, hardware, avionics, cyber, safety/airworthiness, and aircraft modification.
Coordinate engineering execution with Program Management through EVMS, technical performance metrics, and integrated master schedule alignment.
Lead engineering readiness events, major design reviews, integration milestones, and customer technical engagements.
Responsible for technical direction across all SEIT functions with decision authority over technical execution, ensuring the system meets requirements and mission CONOPS.
Ensure successful technical execution of the program by maintaining a cohesive, end-to-end engineering approach across all IPTs.
Evaluate and drive critical requirements into the program baseline, ensuring systems engineering, cybersecurity/IA, development, integration, test, and operational needs are satisfied to contract compliance.
Provide oversight and review of engineering metrics, offering clear summaries and action plans to leadership and customer stakeholders.
Lead Engineering Review Board (ERB) change management, integration of customer-driven change, defect management, and root-cause/performance-management actions.
Ensure application of Technical Performance Measures (TPMs) to track engineering progress, assess risk, and identify emerging issues.
Oversee and manage the SEIT Risk & Opportunity process, leveraging enterprise capabilities to reduce risk and capture opportunities.
Identify and exploit synergies across the SAOC program and RTX enterprise engineering activities.
Ensure systems engineering baselines are horizontally and vertically consistent across all technical artifacts, IPTs, and engineering processes.
Collaborate across engineering, supplier organizations, and customer stakeholders to ensure technical performance meets mission needs.
Drive mission success by ensuring engineering quality, architecture integrity, technical risk reduction, and disciplined systems engineering execution.
Provide executive-level communication and influence to guide senior decision-making across a matrixed organization.
Support engineering excellence through workforce mentorship, coaching, and development across geographically distributed teams.
Drive technical performance and ensure mission success on large defense programs.
Communicate effectively with executive/senior leaders to build alignment and influence key decisions.

Qualifications You Must Have

Experience as a SEIT IPT Lead, Chief Engineer, Program Engineer, or IPT Lead on a major program.
Experience managing large software and systems development programs across multiple environments.
Strong knowledge of multiple engineering disciplines, including large-scale software development, IPDS, and EVMS.
Experience managing suppliers in technical or programmatic oversight roles.
Experience across all phases of the program lifecycle.
Experience leading geographically dispersed teams and operating effectively in a matrixed environment.
Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 14 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 12 years of experience

Qualifications We Prefer

Active and transferable U.S. government issued DoD Top Secret clearance is required prior to start date.
Leadership experience on ACAT I–equivalent or multi-hundred-million-dollar programs.
Experience applying MBSE, digital engineering, and model-based verification.
Experience leading technical transformation efforts or process modernization initiatives.

added.description:
Job Description

onsemi
is seeking an industry leading AI and semiconductor technology executive to define, build, and govern the next generation of AI-enabled New Product Development (NPD).

This leader will establish the vision, strategy, operating model, and governance framework for Agentic AI across the semiconductor design lifecycle, enabling AI-assisted and AI-driven development of analog, mixed-signal, power management, sensing, memory, verification, layout, test, packaging, and system architectures.

The role will serve as the executive authority for Agentic AI Design Engineering and will lead the transformation of semiconductor development workflows through reusable AI agents, advanced reasoning systems, design knowledge repositories, and AI-enabled engineering methodologies.

Success in this role will materially improve engineering productivity, accelerate product development cycles, increase IP reuse, enhance design quality, and establish onsemi
as an industry leader in AI-enabled semiconductor development.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Define Enterprise AI NPD Vision

Develop and execute the long term strategy for Agentic AI-enabled semiconductor product development.
Create the roadmap for AI deployment across product planning, architecture, design, verification, physical implementation, characterization, test, reliability, applications, and documentation.
Define the maturity model for AI-assisted, AI-enabled, and AI-native development methodologies.
Establish objectives, success metrics, and business outcomes tied to engineering productivity and NPD execution.

Build the Agentic Design Platform

Lead creation of an enterprise Agentic AI framework supporting:
Analog design agents
Digital design agents
Verification agents
Layout agents
Test engineering agents
Applications engineering agents
Documentation and requirements agents
Program management agents

Define standards for agent architecture, interoperability, orchestration, security, and lifecycle management.
Partner with engineering, CAD, IT, and infrastructure teams to deploy scalable AI design environments.

Develop processes for agent qualification, validation, release, version control, maintenance, retirement, and reuse.
Create an "Agent Library" and corporate repository of approved agents, prompts, workflows, and design knowledge.
Define review and approval processes for new internally developed agents.
Ensure cross division reuse of agents.

Transform Analog and Digital Design

Define AI-enabled methodologies across:
Circuit design
Architecture exploration
RTL development
Verification
Physical design
Device characterization
Design reviews
Failure analysis
Documentation generation

Drive deployment of AI workflows into production engineering environments.
Identify high-value use cases capable of delivering significant improvements in development cycle time, engineering efficiency, and design quality.

Create the AI Governance Operating Model

Define AI governance policies for engineering workflows.
Establish standards for:
Model selection
Training data usage
Intellectual property protection
Security and access controls
Human-in-the-loop decision processes
Validation requirements
Auditability and traceability

Ensure responsible deployment of AI systems across engineering organizations.

Drive Measurable Business Outcomes

Establish KPI frameworks measuring:
NPD cycle time
Design productivity
Engineering efficiency
Agent reuse rates
AI adoption
Design quality improvements
Verification coverage improvements
IP creation velocity

Deliver measurable improvements in development throughput and engineering effectiveness.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline.
15+ years of semiconductor industry experience.
10+ years of leadership experience in product development, EDA, design methodology, CAD, semiconductor software, or AI-enabled engineering environments.
Deep understanding of semiconductor development workflows including:
Analog design
Digital design
Verification
Physical design
Design automation
Semiconductor manufacturing flows

Experience leading complex cross-functional engineering organizations.
Proven ability to influence executive leadership and drive organizational transformation.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Electrical Engineering, AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related field.
Experience developing AI-enabled EDA tools, semiconductor design automation platforms, or Agentic AI systems.
Hands-on experience with:
LLMs
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Multi-Agent Architectures
Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Workflow Orchestration Platforms
Reinforcement Learning
AI Copilots
Knowledge Graphs

Background in organizational AI transformation programs.

added.description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com.

Job Description

The Vice President, Software & Controls Engineering is responsible for the digital realization of Fluence's global product portfolio and serves as the executive leader for all software and controls engineering disciplines across the Product Business Unit. Reporting to the Head of Product Business Unit, this executive leads the global organization responsible for embedded software, controls engineering, Battery Management System (BMS) software, Energy Management System (EMS), Site Controller software, SCADA, cloud platforms, fleet management, software quality, cybersecurity implementation, and software development infrastructure.

Working in close partnership with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Product Management, Program Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Customer Success, and Digital organizations, this leader ensures Fluence delivers secure, scalable, reliable, and high-performing software platforms that differentiate its products and create long-term customer value.

Responsibilities Include

Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the long-term Software & Controls Engineering strategy aligned with the Product Business Unit strategy, technology roadmap, and business objectives.
Establish the global Software & Controls Engineering operating model, engineering standards, software governance, development methodologies, and organizational capability roadmap.
Develop long-term investment strategies for software platforms, cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, AI-enabled engineering capabilities, simulation environments, automation, and software development infrastructure.
Establish annual operating objectives, software engineering KPIs, resource plans, investment priorities, and organizational development strategies.
Serve as a member of the Product Business Unit Leadership Team, contributing to technology strategy, digital innovation, organizational planning, and business performance.

Software & Controls Engineering Leadership

Lead the global engineering organizations responsible for embedded software, BMS, EMS, Site Controller, controls engineering, SCADA, cloud applications, fleet management platforms, edge computing, APIs, software infrastructure, and digital product engineering.
Translate approved system architectures into scalable, secure, reliable, and high-performing software and controls solutions.
Establish enterprise software engineering standards governing software implementation, coding standards, reusable platforms, release governance, and technical documentation.
Lead software design reviews, controls engineering reviews, software release readiness reviews, and technical decision-making.
Drive Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, SSDLC, software configuration management, and release management best practices.
Own engineering support for NPI, software integration, manufacturing readiness, field deployment, software releases, product updates, and lifecycle maintenance.
Lead development of advanced controls, optimization algorithms, AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, and next-generation digital capabilities.

Digital Product Lifecycle Leadership

Lead software engineering from concept through implementation, validation, deployment, sustainment, feature enhancements, and end-of-life planning.
Partner with Systems Engineering to ensure software realizes the approved system architecture and achieves performance, safety, cybersecurity, and certification objectives.
Drive software quality improvement through defect reduction, field issue resolution, root cause investigations, corrective actions, observability, and continuous improvement.
Lead software lifecycle planning, technical debt reduction, platform standardization, third-party software governance, and technology refresh initiatives.
Ensure software platforms remain compliant with evolving cybersecurity, regulatory, functional safety, grid code, and customer requirements.

Digital Engineering Excellence

Establish engineering excellence through modern software practices, AI-assisted development, software reuse strategies, and continuous improvement.
Lead software development infrastructure, DevSecOps platforms, automated testing frameworks, simulation capabilities, and engineering productivity tools.
Develop engineering metrics that improve software quality, deployment frequency, release predictability, platform stability, and customer satisfaction.
Drive adoption of cloud-native architectures, edge computing, containerization, platform modularity, digital twins, and emerging technologies.

Organizational Leadership

Build and lead a world-class global Software & Controls Engineering organization through workforce planning, succession management, coaching, mentoring, and capability building.
Establish engineering career paths, software competency frameworks, technical leadership programs, and knowledge management practices.
Lead software engineering resource planning, budget management, organization design, engineering productivity improvements, and continuous process optimization.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, technical excellence, inclusion, and continuous learning.

Business Leadership

Partner with Product Management to evaluate software platform strategies, digital product capabilities, technology investments, and business cases.
Collaborate across Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Program Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Customer Success, Services, and Digital organizations to deliver integrated solutions.
Represent Fluence with customers, technology partners, software vendors, standards organizations, cybersecurity organizations, and industry associations.
Champion digital innovation, engineering excellence, software quality, and continuous improvement.

WHAT WILL YOU BRING TO FLUENCE?

20+ years of progressive software engineering leadership in complex industrial or enterprise product environments.
10+ years leading global Software Engineering organizations.
Demonstrated success delivering embedded software, controls, cloud platforms, and digital products at scale.
Deep expertise in software engineering, controls, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, cloud technologies, and digital product development.
Proven ability to build high-performing engineering organizations and develop technical leaders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline required; Master's degree, MBA, or equivalent preferred.
20+ years of engineering leadership experience developing complex software products.
10+ years leading global software engineering organizations.
Expertise in embedded software, controls, cloud platforms, DevSecOps, CI/CD, cybersecurity, software quality, and release management.
Experience with Agile development, software lifecycle management, NPI, and cross-functional product development.
Strong executive leadership, organizational development, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Experience in energy storage, industrial automation, automotive, power systems, or similar industries preferred.

added.title: Senior Manager / Director, Emerging Applications & Technology Architecture
added.description:
Job Description

Renesas is seeking a visionary and highly influential Sr.Manager / Director of Emerging Applications & Technology Architecture to lead the exploration, definition, and commercialization of next-generation semiconductor-enabled system solutions.

In this role, you will guide a team of world-class architects focused on identifying and developing opportunities in emerging applications and disruptive technologies, including AI, robotics, autonomous systems, drones/UAVs, industrial automation, functional safety, edge intelligence, and other high-growth market segments.

You will serve as a strategic bridge between customers, ecosystem partners, product groups, and engineering organizations, transforming market opportunities into differentiated system solutions and future product requirements. Success in this role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, business acumen, leadership excellence, and the ability to influence across multiple organizations.

Key Responsibilities

Technology & Market Leadership

Define and drive Renesas' system architecture strategy for emerging applications and emerging technologies.

Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new market opportunities, technology trends, and high-growth application segments.

Translate customer challenges, technology disruptions, and market requirements into actionable system architectures and solution roadmaps.

Lead competitive benchmarking and technology assessments to identify capability gaps and future investment opportunities.

added.description:
Channel Fusion is accelerating its AI-enabled platform strategy and technical organization during a critical growth window. We are seeking a full-time Chief Technology Officer to lead AI strategy, technical modernization, and architecture direction: establishing a rigorous, real-time operating system and measurement framework for engineering that provides visibility into output, quality, and business impact, and building a comprehensive technical foundation that demonstrates platform scalability, architectural maturity, and operational excellence. This is a full-time, hands-on operating role — not an advisory role.

The CTO owns technology strategy, architecture standards, AI-enabled engineering transformation, cybersecurity and platform-risk direction, technology investment priorities, and enterprise technical readiness. The Head of Engineering reports to the CTO and owns the engineering organization, engineering people leadership, and day-to-day software delivery. The VP, Cloud Security & Client Delivery also reports to the CTO and owns cloud and security operations, compliance execution, service reliability, and client-delivery execution. The CTO aligns these functions and resolves cross-functional technology, roadmap, security, client, and investment tradeoffs with the CEO and executive leadership team.

Core Mandate

Technical Readiness & Operating Baseline
— Build a comprehensive technical foundation that demonstrates platform scalability, architectural maturity, and operational excellence to internal stakeholders and enterprise partners. This includes: stored-procedure inventory, technical debt registry (with owner, business impact, remediation plan for every material item), modernization status evidence (production validation, monitoring, rollback testing, legacy deprecation), and infrastructure/scalability metrics (concurrent users, transactions per minute, multi-tenant support, cost per 1,000 transactions).
Client Onboarding Scalability
— Establish clear metrics and targets for client onboarding efficiency, documentation, and platform-driven configuration to enable faster, more predictable client launches, and build the roadmap to onboard new clients at scale without linear growth in engineering headcount.
AI Strategy & Productivity
— Establish an engineering baseline and launch a controlled AI-assisted delivery pilot within the first 30 days using a live codebase and real delivery workflows. Within the first 90 days, demonstrate measurable improvement in cycle time or throughput without deterioration in quality, security, or production reliability. Define a validated rollout plan for the remaining pods based on pilot results, including projected engineering and AI-tooling economics.
Architecture Direction
— The CTO will initially serve as Channel Fusion's senior architecture authority and assess the technical-leadership model during the first 30 days. The CTO may recommend principal-level architecture capacity where demonstrated workload, technical risk, or delivery leverage justifies it. Any such position will be structured as a hands-on technical role within the engineering organization rather than as an additional management layer.
Operating Framework
— Establish a real-time management system that provides visibility into organizational output: a weekly pod-level scorecard (mission, committed vs. delivered outcomes, revenue/retention supported, team size, work mix, cycle time, quality, loaded cost, and capacity, investment, ownership, and operating recommendations for each pod), and a technology economics model (fully loaded org cost, cost by pod, revenue/retention by pod, AI tooling/token costs, RPE tracking against target, and modeled efficiency, investment, capacity, and operating-leverage scenarios).
Executive & Board Engagement
— Report progress against a monthly operating and readiness dashboard directly to the CEO/ELT; translate technical reality into terms leadership and enterprise partners can act on.

Key Qualifications

15+ years of technology leadership experience within enterprise software, SaaS, MarTech, or channel marketing platforms; prior experience as CTO, SVP, or VP of Engineering/Technology at meaningful scale.
Personally designed and led the implementation of an AI-assisted software delivery system in a live engineering organization —
not simply sponsored, approved, or directed one from a distance. Able to speak specifically to the tools, workflow design, failure modes encountered, and measurable before-and-after results (cycle time, defect rates, throughput, or cost).
Track record modernizing legacy platforms while continuing to ship to live, paying clients
— real modernization under real constraints, not a greenfield build or an unconstrained migration.
Experience leading distributed engineering organizations, including India-based teams
— familiar with the timezone, communication, and career-development dynamics required to build genuine technical ownership and trust across geography.
Able to connect technical investment decisions to business outcomes
— client onboarding speed, release velocity, operational resilience, and enterprise value — not just architectural or code-quality terms.
Deep working knowledge of modern AI technologies: LLMs, tokenization, prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, GPU/cloud AI infrastructure, and AI software stacks, sufficient to personally design and lead an AI-native engineering organization.
Experience directing enterprise-grade, cloud-native, secure, multi-tenant SaaS architecture at the senior-most technical level.
Technical diligence experience
— has built or defended a technical readiness package (debt inventory, architecture risk, scalability evidence) for board, executive, enterprise-partner, or other senior stakeholder review.
Excellent executive communication skills; able to lead a multi-functional technical organization (engineering, cloud/security, and client delivery) as a unified executive team.
Genuine investment in building organizational bench strength over time, including mentoring and developing technical leaders as part of a collaborative, growth-oriented leadership approach.
MarTech / Through-Channel Marketing Automation (TCMA) experience — desirable, not required.

Education

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent demonstrated experience required; advanced technical or business education preferred.
What Success Looks Like — First 90 Days

A complete, evidence-based Technology Operating Pack in active use (pod scorecard, AI productivity proof, tech economics, engineering operations charter, technical readiness baseline).
Clear, quantified metrics and targets for client onboarding efficiency and platform-driven configuration, with a documented roadmap to scale.
A monthly operating and readiness dashboard populated with real baselines and trending in the right direction on debt reduction, modernization, and scalability.
At least one priority engineering pod has used the new AI-assisted delivery system to ship a meaningful client-visible or operationally important production outcome, with documented before-and-after evidence covering cycle time, quality, cost, and required manual effort.
A validated resilience and disaster-recovery baseline is complete, including recovery-time and recovery-point requirements, backup and restoration evidence, material infrastructure risks, and a prioritized remediation plan.
Clear decision rights, operating boundaries, escalation paths, and shared performance metrics are established across the CTO, Head of Engineering, and VP, Cloud Security & Client Delivery — including the interfaces among engineering delivery, cloud operations, security and compliance, client commitments, and architecture governance.

Purpose of Position:
The Vice President of Information Technology leads GrowGeneration’s IT function and develops and executes a practical technology roadmap in partnership with the CFO and business leaders. The role is accountable for reliable, secure, and effective technology systems; IT service delivery; technology investments; data management; and the responsible adoption and use of artificial intelligence (AI) across the company. Oversee technology business continuity and resilience planning, including disaster recovery, system recovery, backup integrity, critical application dependencies, and periodic testing to ensure the organization can maintain or restore critical operations following a technology disruption.
Serve as the senior technology advisor to executive leadership, translating business objectives into technology strategies and clearly communicating technology opportunities, risks, investments, and priorities.
Develop and execute the IT roadmap, priorities, service levels, and project plans in alignment with business needs, strategic objectives, and approved budgets; report progress, risks, dependencies, and resource needs.
Lead, develop, and manage the IT team; oversee technology support for corporate, retail, distribution, and digital operations; establish clear ownership, escalation paths, service standards, and performance measures.
Partner with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial, and other business leaders on technology strategy, system selection, implementation, process improvement, and integrations, including ERP, ecommerce, and acquired businesses.
Manage technology budgets, procurement, software licensing, vendor performance, contracts, and capital proposals; evaluate technology investments based on cost, security, implementation requirements, scalability, and measurable business value.

Cybersecurity, privacy, and controls
Own and oversee the company’s information security program, including identity and access management, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, security awareness, and periodic testing of security controls and recovery plans.
Maintain and oversee IT policies, standards, and procedures related to information security, privacy, data retention, acceptable use, and technology risk in coordination with Legal and other control owners.
Maintain and document IT general controls supporting financial reporting and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance; coordinate audit evidence, remediation activities, and control testing with Internal Audit and external auditors.
Assess technology, data, cybersecurity, and integration risks associated with acquisitions, new locations, significant vendors, and major technology or system changes.

AI and Data Management
Develop and execute an AI adoption strategy in partnership with business leaders; identify and prioritize use cases, oversee controlled pilots, measure outcomes, and scale solutions that improve productivity, customer service, operational efficiency, or decision-making.
Establish and oversee AI governance in partnership with Legal and business owners, including approved tools and vendors, data access and confidentiality requirements, human oversight of consequential outputs, testing, monitoring, and employee training.
Establish and oversee the company’s data management framework, including data ownership, definitions, quality standards, master data, access controls, retention, and data lineage where appropriate; ensure effective resolution of data quality and integrity issues across systems.
Partner with Finance and operating teams to improve data integration, reporting, and analytics; establish trusted data sources and appropriate controls over key operational and financial metrics.
Additional duties as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; advanced degree is a plus.
At least 10 years of progressive IT experience, including at least 5 years leading teams, vendors, and complex cross functional projects.
Experience with enterprise applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, business continuity, and IT governance; experience in a SOX compliant public company environment is required.
Demonstrated ability to improve data quality and reporting and to evaluate or deploy AI tools with sound security, privacy, and human oversight.
Strong financial judgment, vendor management, communication, and problem-solving skills; ability to explain technical risks and investment choices to business leaders.
